subject: Mythology
title: Saraswati: Goddess of Knowledge
description: A 60-second lesson on Saraswati: Goddess of Knowledge.

hook.text: Saraswati invented language, music, and learning. Without her, no god or human could speak or think.

buildup.text: She sits on a white lotus, dressed in white, playing a veena — the instrument she created to give the world melody.

discovery.text: Students across India worship her before exams, placing books and instruments at her feet for blessings.

twist.text: Unlike Lakshmi, Saraswati favors the humble. She avoids the wealthy and visits those who seek knowledge sincerely.

climax.text: Her festival, Vasant Panchami, marks the start of spring and is celebrated with yellow clothes and feasting.

punchline.text: The goddess of knowledge chose the classroom over the palace.

quiz.question: What did Saraswati create according to Hindu mythology?
options: The rivers and oceans of the world
Language, music, and all forms of learning
The weapons the gods used to fight demons
